titlePattern.gap: Thin walls and neighbors: picks that suit a small apartment's noise limits, plus roommate privacy

commonPoints: The Amazon Echo Dot is the default budget or all-round Alexa pick
Choose the assistant that matches the phone and services you already use
The HomePod mini is the compact pick for Apple households
A low-cost compact speaker is enough sound for a small room

ourGain.point: Footprint table from published specs: Echo Dot 100 x 100 x 89 mm vs HomePod mini 97.9 mm wide, 84.3 mm high vs Echo Spot about 113 x 103 x 111 mm; Dot and HomePod mini are within about 2 mm in width, HomePod mini is the lowest for shelves with little headroom

Affordable chooser: Echo Dot (Alexa) or Nest Mini (Google) as the two lower-cost picks; pay more only for Apple Home (HomePod mini) or a bedside screen (Echo Spot); outside the US, check the assistant is sold in your country and speaks your language
Shared-wall placement: keep speakers off shelves touching a shared wall, pad hard surfaces, quiet hours after 10 pm, not by the front door
Roommate privacy: voice profiles, voice purchasing off, mic mute, no speakers in other people's bedrooms
Bedside pick: the Echo Spot replaces an alarm clock, so in a small bedroom it frees nightstand space despite being the largest
